resolutions.judgement: Applied verbatim and it is the right fix: the row now names the action with the same verb as the mesh control (移回此设备), the full refusal it shortens (ui.mesh.mesh_drop.recall_first -> 请先将其移回此处) and this file's sibling sentence.remote (…点击可将其移回此处…). The clause stays lowercase-style, keeps the semicolon, and drops no trailing punctuation, matching EN and the two other stand-down reasons.

findings.current: 此对话在此设备上运行。点击可将其迁移到其他设备，或稍后召回。
findings.source: This conversation runs on this device. Click to move it to another device or recall it later.
findings.problem: 召回 is the only occurrence of 召回 in the zh-CN catalogue; EN's recall reads 移回 in five shipped places, including the control this chip opens. Naming the action with a word the control never uses costs the reader a translation step. Pre-existing (it predates wave B and the earlier audit listed it under verified-no-finding); this wave made it the sole outlier by fixing row.not_here_why.
findings.suggested: 此对话在此设备上运行。点击可将其迁移到其他设备，或稍后移回此处。
findings.severity_note: MINOR, not MAJOR: the meaning is never ambiguous (the destination control reads 移回此设备 on the same screen) and the sentence is a tooltip/accessible name for a chip whose label already says where the conversation runs. Not a shipping blocker; a one-line, wider-by-4-cells fix in a file this wave already touches.
